claims.text: Many reviewers praise the pleasant scent of the product.
Several reviewers report that the product leaves hair greasy or weighed down, especially on fine hair.
Multiple reviewers say it makes hair manageable, shiny, and helps with tangles and curls.
Some reviewers note the product is not tearless and can sting or burn children's eyes.
A few reviewers question the product's organic claims or suspect a formula change causing scalp irritation.
